# Ixiera
> AI-powered Threads content planning, scheduling, reply automation, and analytics platform for creators and businesses.

## Official URLs
- Website: https://ixiera.online
- Web Application: https://app.ixiera.online
- Privacy Policy: https://ixiera.online/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://ixiera.online/terms

## Core Features
- AI 3-Day Content Planner & Quick Score post evaluation
- Automated Threads post scheduling, location tagging, and cross-posting to Instagram
- AI comment & mention management (Manual Review and Full Auto modes with custom brand Knowledge Base)
- Official Threads Trending Topics discovery & account/media performance analytics
